name: INTERFACE
summary: Design and critique UI against enforceable rules: accessibility, touch targets, spacing, type scale, semantic color, motion, and forms.

cursor.rule_description: Use when a task changes how a feature looks, feels, moves, or is interacted with — building or reviewing UI, layout, components, color, type, or motion. Skip for pure backend, API, DB, or DevOps work.
